payload.reason: The evidence provides specific performance metrics and comparisons for different models on the tasks of speculation detection and scope resolution, which can be interpreted as the baselines for these tasks.

claims.text: The baseline for speculation detection on the BioScope Full Papers (BF) dataset is an F1 score gain of 0.42 points when trained on a single dataset.
The baseline for speculation detection on the BioScope Abstracts (BA) dataset is an F1 score gain of 1.98 points when trained on a single dataset.
The baseline for speculation detection on the SFU Review Corpus (SFU) dataset is an F1 score gain of 0.29 points when trained on a single dataset.
The baseline for scope resolution on the BF dataset is an F1 score gain of 8.06 points when trained on a single dataset.
The baseline for scope resolution on the BA dataset is an F1 score gain of 4.27 points when trained on a single dataset.
The baseline for scope resolution on the SFU dataset is an F1 score gain of 11.87 points when trained on a single dataset.
